name: Stasis
author: he-zhiyuan
description: Rest timer for the Omarchy bar: freezes keyboard and mouse for a set time, then unlocks.

barWidget.description: Start a timed input-blocking rest and show the remaining time in the bar.

schema.label: stasis binary
schema.description: Path to the stasis executable (the daemon and the widget must use the same build).

schema.label: Rest lengths (minutes)
schema.description: Comma-separated list shown in the popup.

schema.label: rest-break status file (optional)
schema.description: Shows work time and next rest from rest-break. Leave empty to probe $XDG_STATE_HOME/rest-break/status.json and ~/stasis/rest-break/.
